patch: 0.5.1 (practice: written from the notes at poe2db.tw/Version_0.5.1, 2026-11-22, before looking at PoB's update)

changes.note: Conductive Runes now has a base Critical Strike Chance of 7%.
Repulsion's Triggered Wave now has a base Critical Strike Chance of 6%.

not_expressible_yet: Cold / Lightning / Fire Attunement: no longer limited to Attacks; now Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Cold / Lightning / Fire (a new stat, not a number change)
Ice Bite I / II, Innervate: no longer limited to Attacks; new gain-as effects for 5 / 6 s
Refutation's Cooldown no longer recovers while the Buff is active (a rule)
Stampede now has 20% more Area of Effect as its special effect (a new stat)
Ascendancy, rune and unique changes (Archon of Chayula, Eternal Life, Virtuous Barrier, Revered Vestments, Emergent Instinct)
